description: Follows Leibniz’s Hanoverian service, correspondence, academy-building and the calculus priority dispute. Explores his work on catenaries and mechanics, stepped-drum calculation, binary arithmetic and formal reasoning, alongside theological and philosophical debates about space, time and the nature of physical explanation.
